text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos put on a brilliant performance in 
the Shion Stakes. With no signs of fatigue 
or physical issues, she was brimming with 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next up at last is the final crown, the 
Shuka Sho. With her sights set on winning 
the Tiara, Vivlos renewed her 
determination.
